scope: Mac mini, Mac Studio and all Apple silicon MacBook families introduced fromM1-era2020 onward, including2026A18ProMacBookNeo; noIntelmachines. Separate chiptiers retained even when enclosures shared.

coordinate_conventions.dimensions_mm: Physical width left-to-right, depth front-to-back, height bottom-to-top with laptop lid closed. Translate into rendering framework coordinates explicitly.
coordinate_conventions.port_uv: u left-to-right in straight front/rear view; laptop side u front-to-back. v top-to-bottom on the exposed aluminum face. Approximate normalized photo placement, not mechanical datums.
coordinate_conventions.display: Full native rectangular pixel extent; native aspect retained. Rounded corners and centered camera housing remove visible areas; notch envelope estimates are not manufacturer CAD.

accuracy.published: Official Apple envelope dimensions, display resolution/diagonal/ppi, finish names, existence/year and model identifiers.
accuracy.estimated: Corner/fillet radii, lid/base split, notch dimensions, logo dimensions, opening sizes/positions, vents and foot details.
accuracy.materials: Finishes are names only; RGB, roughness and metal shaders must remain explicitly estimated.
accuracy.rights: Procedural descriptions and measurements; Apple branding/reference image URLs identify Apple-owned material. No downloaded reference photos included.

reference_review.finding: Official identification index explicitly lists 2026 Mac mini M6 and M5 Pro, 2024 M4/M4 Pro, 2023 M2/M2 Pro and 2020 M1; no M3 or M5 base mini added.
Official identification index explicitly lists 2026 M5 Max/M5 Ultra, 2025 M4 Max/M3 Ultra, 2023 M2 Max/M2 Ultra and 2022 M1 Max/M1 Ultra Studio models.
Inspected straight modern mini front: two vertical USB-C openings left, status light then audio jack right; Apple logo lies on top plane, never front. Slotted black cooling foot beneath aluminum.
Inspected combined front/rear: blank front with tiny right LED, black rear insert, horizontal USB openings, audio beneath right USB-A group, horizontal lower exhaust.
Same older footprint with four rear USB-C Thunderbolt openings, not two. Other rear openings remain individually placed.
Inspected Studio front: two vertical USB-C/TB openings and SD slot near lower left, white status light lower right; tall body and lower black vent lip.
Inspected Studio rear: broad upper perforated vent, lower row of four vertical USB-C, Ethernet, mains inlet, two vertical USB-A, HDMI/audio and power button.
Inspected original Air wedge side: two horizontal USB-C openings toward hinge; front edge far thinner than back. No MagSafe or display notch.
Inspected flat Air side: MagSafe plus two USB-C openings on left toward hinge; headphone on right. No external speaker grilles beside keyboard in the newer flat Air design.
Inspected notched Pro right side: SDXC nearest front, then USB-C, HDMI toward hinge; base M3 14 omits right USB-C.
Inspected notched Pro left side: MagSafe nearest hinge, then two USB-C, then headphone. Full-height function row rather than old 13-inch Touch Bar.

Official2026NeoA18Pro exists alongsideM-seriesAir/Pro; inspected straight front,finishgroup,andcroppedleft/rightsidephotos. No notch orMagSafe;2leftUSB-Cwithdifferentprotocols;rightheadphoneandside-speakerslit. TouchID512GB isconfigurationoption, notseparatefamily.
